# asset-library-organization-planner

Purpose: Plan an internal asset library structure (folders, naming, metadata, license tracking, version control) so future recipes find and reuse assets reliably.

Plan a maintainable internal asset library structure (folder tree, naming convention, per-asset metadata schema, license-tracking strategy, version-control rules, migration steps, and review process) so future recipes can: - find existing assets quickly, - avoid re-licensing the same source, - reuse PBR materials and HDRIs, - track versions and revisions, - serve as the internal-library source for `blender-asset-discovery-planner` and `asset-fallback-strategy`.

Metadata: Contract `v1.0.0` | Category `asset-and-sourcing` | Role `local-asset-library-taxonomy-planner` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- starting a new BlendOps repo with multiple recipes
- existing library is disorganized; recipes can't find assets
- before scaling to 50+ assets
- Trigger phrases: "organize the assets", "asset library structure", "where should assets go", "name our assets"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- single-recipe repo with < 5 assets → use `blender-asset-discovery-planner` (`references/skill-blender-asset-discovery-planner.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blender-asset-discovery-planner)
- pure planning before any asset categories or storage constraints are known → use `asset-license-checker` (`references/skill-asset-license-checker.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to asset-license-checker)
- sourcing or acquiring external assets → use `blender-asset-discovery-planner` (`references/skill-blender-asset-discovery-planner.md`; use blender-asset-discovery-planner)
- verifying asset licenses → use `asset-license-checker` (`references/skill-asset-license-checker.md`; use asset-license-checker)
- checking visual style consistency across assets → use `asset-style-consistency-checker` (`references/skill-asset-style-consistency-checker.md`; use asset-style-consistency-checker)
- planning fallback substitutions when an asset is missing or fails → use `asset-fallback-strategy` (`references/skill-asset-fallback-strategy.md`; use asset-fallback-strategy)
- enforcing file size or polygon/asset count performance budgets → use `glb-mobile-performance-budget` (`references/skill-glb-mobile-performance-budget.md`; use glb-mobile-performance-budget)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `raw_asset_inventory` (`array`): List of 3D models, PBR material sets, HDRIs, and license sidecar files to organize
- Required input `project_storage_scope` (`string`): Whether the library is project-local or shared across multiple BlendOps packs
- Optional input `naming_prefix_convention` (`string`): Optional studio or project naming prefix for datablocks and folders
- Output contract: `directory_taxonomy_plan`, `datablock_naming_rules`, `quarantine_and_license_sidecar_policy` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. pin folder structure (kebab-case, by category)
2. pin naming convention (asset name + version + license slug)
3. pin metadata schema (license, source, date, version, hash)
4. pin version control rules (LFS for large binaries, plain text for metadata)
5. emit a library-init plan

## Cross-skill handoffs
- [upstream_reference] External asset sourcing into this library → `blender-asset-discovery-planner` (`references/skill-blender-asset-discovery-planner.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; assets.discoveryComplete equals false]`
- [upstream_reference] License verification (license file next to asset; unlicensed old assets to Quarantine) → `asset-license-checker` (`references/skill-asset-license-checker.md`) — `when.all: [assets.externalUsed equals true; assets.licenseCleared equals false]`
- [upstream_reference] Visual style consistency checks → `asset-style-consistency-checker` (`references/skill-asset-style-consistency-checker.md`) — `when.all: [assets.licenseCleared equals true; stage.current equals "style_check"]`
- [fallback] Consuming this library as fastest fallback source → `asset-fallback-strategy` (`references/skill-asset-fallback-strategy.md`) — `when.all: [assets.fallbackNeeded equals true]`
- [progression] File size and asset/polygon count pressure → `glb-mobile-performance-budget` (`references/skill-glb-mobile-performance-budget.md`) — `when.all: [artifact.type equals "glb"; budget.pinned equals false]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Planning skill — never moves files, never configures git/LFS/DAM, never runs Blender, and never produces library files. Outputs a structure spec, migration steps, and review process only.
- Move, rename, or delete files.
- Configure git, Git LFS, Perforce, or DAM tools.
- Run Blender or execute Python.
- Buy or source external assets (use `blender-asset-discovery-planner`).
- Verify licenses, style consistency, or performance budgets (use `asset-license-checker`, `asset-style-consistency-checker`, `glb-mobile-performance-budget`).
